class.name: GDScriptReflection
class.brief_description: Read-only GDScript reflection and dynamic-proxy API, reached through [code]godot.reflection[/code].

method.name: create_proxy_dynamic
method.description: Builds a dynamic proxy of the trait or abstract type [param type] whose every contract call is routed through [param handler], invoked as [code]handler.call(method_name, args)[/code]. [param type] may be a [Script] class handle or a typed class handle stored in a [code]Type[T][/code] variable. [param type] must be a trait or abstract type whose native base is [RefCounted] or a [RefCounted]-derived type such as [Resource]. The returned object satisfies [code]is type[/code], so it can be assigned to a variable of that type; [code]null[/code] is returned and an error is printed on invalid input.

method.name: create_delegating_proxy
method.description: Builds a delegating proxy for the trait or abstract type [param type] in the "intercept some, pass the rest through" style. [param type] may be a [Script] class handle or a typed class handle stored in a [code]Type[T][/code] variable. [param type] must be a trait or abstract type whose native base is [RefCounted] or a [RefCounted]-derived type such as [Resource]. Every contract method whose name is a key in [param interceptor] routes to that advice [Callable], invoked as [code]advice.call(method_name, args, target)[/code] so the advice can "proceed" by calling [code]target.callv(method_name, args)[/code]. All other contract methods, and all contract property reads and writes, forward to [param target]. [param target] must implement [param type] (that is, [code]target is type[/code] must hold); otherwise [code]null[/code] is returned and an error is printed. The returned object satisfies [code]is type[/code], so it can be assigned to a variable of that type.

method.name: get_annotation
method.description: Returns the first annotation named [param annotation] applied to the requested declaration, or [code]null[/code] if none matches. [param kind] selects the declaration: [code]"class"[/code] (the [param member] argument is ignored), [code]"method"[/code], [code]"variable"[/code], [code]"signal"[/code], or [code]"constant"[/code]. [param annotation] matches either the short name ([code]"timeout"[/code]) or the qualified name ([code]"cafecito.test.timeout"[/code]). When [param effective] is [code]true[/code] (the default) the member kinds search the script base chain so inherited and trait-flattened declarations are considered; when [code]false[/code] only annotations declared on [param target]'s exact script are considered. Class annotations are direct-only and unaffected by [param effective]. Callers that care about repeated annotations should use [method get_annotations] instead. [param target] may be a [Script] class handle, a typed class handle stored in a [code]Type[T][/code] variable, or an instance whose script is used. Invalid, freed, or non-script targets return [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_annotations
method.description: Returns the annotations applied to the requested declaration in source order, as [GDScriptAnnotation] descriptors. [param kind] selects the declaration: [code]"class"[/code] (the [param member] argument is ignored), [code]"method"[/code], [code]"variable"[/code], [code]"signal"[/code], or [code]"constant"[/code]. When [param effective] is [code]true[/code] (the default) the member kinds search the script base chain so inherited and trait-flattened declarations are included; when [code]false[/code] only annotations declared on [param target]'s exact script are returned. Class annotations are direct-only and unaffected by [param effective]. This is the generic convenience form of [method get_class_annotations], [method get_method_annotations], and [method get_variable_annotations]. [param target] may be a [Script] class handle, a typed class handle stored in a [code]Type[T][/code] variable, or an instance whose script is used. Invalid, freed, or non-script targets return an empty array.

method.name: get_class_annotations
method.description: Returns the annotations applied directly to [param target]'s class declaration, in source order, as [GDScriptAnnotation] descriptors. Class annotations are direct-only: they are not inherited from base scripts. [param target] may be a [Script] class handle, a typed class handle stored in a [code]Type[T][/code] variable, or an instance whose script is used. Invalid, freed, or non-script targets return an empty array.

method.name: get_constant_annotations
method.description: Returns the annotations applied to the constant named [param constant], in source order, as [GDScriptAnnotation] descriptors. When [param effective] is [code]true[/code] (the default) the effective member view is used: a constant declared on a base script carries its annotations when reflected from a derived script. When [code]false[/code] only annotations declared on [param target]'s exact script are returned. [param target] may be a [Script] class handle, a typed class handle stored in a [code]Type[T][/code] variable, or an instance whose script is used. Invalid, freed, or non-script targets return an empty array.

method.name: get_method_annotations
method.description: Returns the annotations applied to the method named [param method], in source order, as [GDScriptAnnotation] descriptors. When [param effective] is [code]true[/code] (the default) the effective method view is used: a method declared on a base script carries its annotations when reflected from a derived script, a concrete trait method flattened into an implementer carries its declaration annotations, and an overriding method's annotations take precedence. When [code]false[/code] only annotations declared on [param target]'s exact script are returned (trait-flattened methods are owned by the implementer, so they remain visible). [param target] may be a [Script] class handle, a typed class handle stored in a [code]Type[T][/code] variable, or an instance whose script is used. Invalid, freed, or non-script targets return an empty array.

method.name: get_method_descriptor
method.description: Returns a structured [GDScriptMethodDescriptor] for the method named [param method] declared by [param target]'s script or one of its base scripts, or [code]null[/code] if the method is not declared. This is the typed equivalent of [method get_method_info]; the descriptor's [method GDScriptMethodDescriptor.to_dictionary] reproduces that method's [Dictionary]. For a GDScript target the descriptor's [member GDScriptMethodDescriptor.annotations] holds the effective annotations, matching [method get_method_annotations]. [param target] may be a [Script] class handle, a typed class handle stored in a [code]Type[T][/code] variable, or an instance whose script is used.

method.name: get_method_descriptors
method.description: Returns structured [GDScriptMethodDescriptor] objects for every method declared by [param target]'s script and its base scripts. This is the typed equivalent of [method get_methods]; each descriptor's [method GDScriptMethodDescriptor.to_dictionary] reproduces that method's [Dictionary]. For a GDScript target each descriptor's [member GDScriptMethodDescriptor.annotations] holds the annotations of the exact declaration it represents. [param target] may be a [Script] class handle, a typed class handle stored in a [code]Type[T][/code] variable, or an instance whose script is used. Returns an empty array if [param target] has no script.

method.name: get_method_info
method.description: Returns the descriptor for the method named [param method] declared by [param target]'s script or one of its base scripts, in the same shape as the entries of [method Object.get_method_list]. [param target] may be a [Script] class handle, a typed class handle stored in a [code]Type[T][/code] variable, or an instance whose script is used. Returns an empty [Dictionary] if the method is not declared. For a GDScript target the descriptor also carries an [code]"annotations"[/code] key holding the effective annotations as an [GDScriptAnnotation] array (empty when the method has none), matching [method get_method_annotations]. Both custom and Godot built-in annotations (for example [code]@export[/code]) are included; use [member GDScriptAnnotation.builtin] to tell them apart.

method.name: get_methods
method.description: Returns the descriptors of every method declared by [param target]'s script and its base scripts, in the same shape as [method Object.get_method_list]. [param target] may be a [Script] class handle, a typed class handle stored in a [code]Type[T][/code] variable, or an instance whose script is used. Returns an empty array if [param target] has no script. For a GDScript target each descriptor also carries an [code]"annotations"[/code] key holding the effective annotations as an [GDScriptAnnotation] array (empty when the method has none), matching [method get_method_annotations]. Both custom and Godot built-in annotations (for example [code]@export[/code]) are included; use [member GDScriptAnnotation.builtin] to tell them apart.

method.name: get_property_descriptors
method.description: Returns structured [GDScriptPropertyDescriptor] objects for the variables declared by [param target]'s script and its base scripts. This is the typed equivalent of [method get_properties]; each descriptor's [method GDScriptPropertyDescriptor.to_dictionary] reproduces that variable's [Dictionary]. Only declared [code]var[/code]s are returned (category and group headers are omitted). For a GDScript target each descriptor's [member GDScriptPropertyDescriptor.annotations] holds the effective annotations, matching [method get_variable_annotations]. [param target] may be a [Script] class handle, a typed class handle stored in a [code]Type[T][/code] variable, or an instance whose script is used.

method.name: get_properties
method.description: Returns the descriptors of the variables declared by [param target]'s script and its base scripts, in the same shape as [method Object.get_property_list]. Only declared [code]var[/code]s are returned (category and group headers are omitted). [param target] may be a [Script] class handle, a typed class handle stored in a [code]Type[T][/code] variable, or an instance whose script is used. For a GDScript target each descriptor also carries an [code]"annotations"[/code] key holding the effective annotations as an [GDScriptAnnotation] array (empty when the variable has none), matching [method get_variable_annotations]. Both custom and Godot built-in annotations (for example [code]@export[/code]) are included; use [member GDScriptAnnotation.builtin] to tell them apart.

method.name: get_signal_annotations
method.description: Returns the annotations applied to the signal named [param signal], in source order, as [GDScriptAnnotation] descriptors. When [param effective] is [code]true[/code] (the default) the effective member view is used: a signal declared on a base script carries its annotations when reflected from a derived script. When [code]false[/code] only annotations declared on [param target]'s exact script are returned. [param target] may be a [Script] class handle, a typed class handle stored in a [code]Type[T][/code] variable, or an instance whose script is used. Invalid, freed, or non-script targets return an empty array.

method.name: get_variable_annotations
method.description: Returns the annotations applied to the member variable named [param variable], in source order, as [GDScriptAnnotation] descriptors. When [param effective] is [code]true[/code] (the default) the effective member view is used: a variable declared on a base script carries its annotations when reflected from a derived script, a trait-flattened variable carries its declaration annotations, and a shadowing variable's annotations take precedence. When [code]false[/code] only annotations declared on [param target]'s exact script are returned (trait-flattened variables are owned by the implementer, so they remain visible). [param target] may be a [Script] class handle, a typed class handle stored in a [code]Type[T][/code] variable, or an instance whose script is used. Invalid, freed, or non-script targets return an empty array.

method.name: has_annotation
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if an annotation named [param annotation] is applied to the requested declaration. [param kind] selects the declaration: [code]"class"[/code] (the [param member] argument is ignored), [code]"method"[/code], [code]"variable"[/code], [code]"signal"[/code], or [code]"constant"[/code]. [param annotation] matches either the short name or the qualified name. When [param effective] is [code]true[/code] (the default) the member kinds search the script base chain so inherited and trait-flattened declarations are considered; when [code]false[/code] only annotations declared on [param target]'s exact script are considered. Class annotations are direct-only and unaffected by [param effective]. [param target] may be a [Script] class handle, a typed class handle stored in a [code]Type[T][/code] variable, or an instance whose script is used. Invalid, freed, or non-script targets return [code]false[/code].

method.name: get_type_arguments
method.description: Returns the reified generic type arguments bound onto [param target], an instance, as container-type descriptor [Dictionary]s (for example the single [code skip-lint]int[/code] descriptor for an instance created with [code]Box[int].new()[/code]). Returns an empty array when [param target] is not an [Object], is not a GDScript instance, is non-generic, or was created without explicit type arguments.

method.name: implements_trait
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param target] conforms to [param trait]. [param target] may be a [Script] class handle, a typed class handle stored in a [code]Type[T][/code] variable, or an instance whose script is used. [param trait] may be a trait class handle (including a [code]Type[T][/code] value whose represented type is a trait), or a trait identity name ([String] or [StringName]). A trait conforms to itself and to every trait it uses.
